notes: Web 419 — PHANTOM-ROOT-NOV11 (Nov 11, 2026). Web 418's invoice-side fix did NOT kill the Sunday Nov 1 phantom in the owner's hands: the entry survived (he deleted it by hand) and he testified he neither started a session that Sunday nor had auto-start set for it. Root, proven in code: stopSessionAt — the ONLY writer of session records — booked whatever the tracker claimed at stop time (date from the stop day, seconds from the tracker's current claim) with no check that a start ever occurred on the day being booked and no agreement check against the session's pin, which is what every guard (stale heal, closed-day proof, adoption) judges by; the heals reach a shell only on the dashboard tick / visibility cadence, so a stop landing first minted the phantom (the Oct 25 shell booked $136.21 exactly this way). And 418's builder vouched a whole DAY from any one genuinely-started record while Revenue's onSession replaces the day's tracker entry at every stop, so a shell stopping later became the day's entry behind a small genuine record's vouch. Fix, at the two choke points: (1) stopSessionAt's booking gate — judged by the pin first, a cross-day session books only as a genuine overnight carry (pin and derived start naming the same day, the day right before the stop day, span under 24 h, start day not already closed) and then books onto its ORIGINAL start day, never re-dated; any other cross-day stop buries the session exactly like the stale heal (engines and native stood down, tracker idle with the discard marker) and writes NO session entry, NO cloud doc and NO Revenue line; any failure inside the gate falls through to the old behaviour. (2) The shared builder: a tracker entry whose own session hours match a shell record's hours for its date and no genuine record's hours is the shell's booking and never becomes a line; an entry matching neither (a Day Details edit) is untouched. Bench: tools/phantom-root-nov11-test.js 44/44 (the Nov 1 shape — Oct 31 pin, 14.78h banked, stopped Nov 1 — writes nothing; a genuine 22:00 to 01:00 carry books on Oct 31; the mixed-day builder case that reproduced the exact $428.71 line on 418 bytes now emits no line); the suite fails 24 assertions on pristine web 418 bytes. 418's phantom-day suite 39/39 and every stop/invoice neighbour suite unchanged (the six stale version-pin suites fail identically on 418 and 419). | Web 418 — PHANTOM-DAY-NOV1 / GHOST-AUTO-NOV8 / NOV2-SAVE-BLOCK (Nov 11, 2026). Owner screenshot, invoice Line items for Nov 1–15: a 14.78h / $428.71 'from tracker — unconfirmed' line for Nov 1 (a Sunday, his day off — he never worked it), a $0.01 'Auto from tracker' line for Nov 8 (also a Sunday day off), and a red banner refusing to save the invoice at all because Nov 2 holds more than one tracker entry with no dispatch completion. Investigation: every 'Auto from tracker' entry is written by Revenue.onSession from the ONE stopSessionAt path in js/app.js, which dates the session record by its END day — so a session started Oct 31 and only stopped on Nov 1 books its whole span onto Nov 1; the v303/v314 stale-session heals discard such cross-day shells only at cold open / sign-in / first pull, so a stop that lands first books the shell. The $0.01 is a ~1-second session: onSession stores hours rounded to '0.00' but prices from the UNROUNDED hours, so a drip becomes a cent. The save block is invIssue's v79 duplicate refusal. Fixes, all inside the ONE shared day-builder (invCycBuildRevenueLines, consumed by Revenue, the invoice, P&L, the manifest and the dispatch day-earnings read, so they can never disagree): (1) PHANTOM-DAY-NOV1 — the builder takes the sessions store as an optional 6th argument (every first-party caller now passes it): a tracker-sourced day surfaces only if some session record genuinely STARTED that day — its own start (endedAt − seconds, the derivation Revenue's day detail itself uses) falls on the record's own date. Cross-midnight shells and days with no session record produce no line and no duplicate flag. With no sessions evidence the builder behaves exactly as before. (2) GHOST-AUTO-NOV8 — a tracker entry under 0.1 of the pay standard's unit never becomes a line, unconditionally: the same never-money rule Revenue's entryMoneyFlags has held since v116, now spoken by the builder too. (3) NOV2-SAVE-BLOCK — invIssue no longer refuses on duplicateDates; the builder already leaves an unresolved duplicate day OFF the invoice's lines, which is exactly Revenue's own totals rule, and the editor's red '⛔ Saving is blocked' banner is now a plain amber note naming the excluded day. Dispatch and manual entries are never touched, and nothing in his real days moves: Nov 4 11h/$319.00, Nov 5 10h/$290.00, Nov 7 10.5h/$304.50, Nov 9 12.5h/$362.50, Nov 10 7.5h/$217.50 price byte-identical. The phantom ENTRIES themselves still sit in his Revenue records (the builder decides what surfaces; it does not rewrite his books) — deleting the Nov 1 / Nov 8 records in Revenue remains his tap if he wants them gone, and Nov 2's two tracker entries still need his Revenue fix to ever count, but they no longer block invoicing. The v79 duplicate assertions in tools/invoice-cycle-test.js are updated with a supersession note. Bench: tools/phantom-day-nov11-test.js 27/27 — the exact Nov 1 cross-midnight shape, the no-record shape, the no-evidence fallback, the Nov 8 drip (with/without evidence, genuine session or not), a genuine tracker-only day still lining unconfirmed, Nov 2 duplicate excluded yet invIssue succeeding and archiving, the five real days unchanged, and the full screenshot period totalling exactly $1,493.50 over five lines. Neighbours green: invoice-cycle 169/169, revenue-grouped 32/32, invoice-format 78/78, invoice-billto-notes-v298 40/40, revenue-dup-entry-v241 14/14, revenue-paycycle-v302 54/54, revenue-detail-strip-nov10 16/16. (revenue-autoprice-v152, manifest-multiday-summary-v331 and manifest-hours-source-v345 each carry the same 2 stale version-pin failures on pristine 417 — pre-existing, untouched.) Verdict owed in his hands: the Nov 1–15 invoice must show only his five real days, carry the amber Nov 2 note instead of the red block, and save.
